1. Khởi động 10–15 phút: đi bộ thả lỏng:
1. Warm-up 10–15 minutes: walk on a loose rein for 5–10 minutes to loosen joints and muscles; light trot for 5–10 minutes (circles or straight lines, long rein) to get the circulation going.
2. Main work 20–30 minutes: according to the stage (endurance, water work, starting gate, speed control...).
3. Cool-down 10 minutes: slow walk so heart rate and body temperature come down gradually.
4. After the session: wash off sweat, check shoes, legs and muscles; the work rider records results, the trainer reviews.
Stop the session immediately if: uneven gait / lameness, nosebleed, roaring, heart rate does not drop after cool-down, or the horse panics out of control (send a health report to the vet).
